---
title: "WP2 - mRNA differential expression analysis (rRNA-depleted libraries)"
author: "Jakob Giesler"
date: "3/12/2024"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

<br>
**1. load packages**
```{r load packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(BiocManager)
library(DESeq2)
library(knitr)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(ggthemes)
```

<br>
**2. set up script (clean environment, set working directory, set global options)**
```{r housekeeping, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())
setwd("/PATH")
```

<br>
**3. create gene count matrix**
```{r matrix, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
file_list <- list.files("cleaned_bac_counts/", pattern = "cleaned.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

##Merging the Files into a single data frames
#Format Names
GeneID <- read.delim("cleaned_bac_counts/01_WP2-RNA-1-bac_S1.counts_cleaned.txt", header=TRUE)
GeneID <- GeneID$Geneid
GeneID <- as.data.frame(GeneID)

#bind the second column from each file into one file, make the rownames the Gene_ID
df <- do.call(cbind,lapply(file_list,function(fn)read.delim(fn,header=TRUE)[,7]))
rownames(df) <- GeneID$GeneID
df <- as.data.frame(df)

#make the colnames according to sample names, reformat the names
temp = as.data.frame(list.files("cleaned_bac_counts/", pattern="*"))
colnames(temp) <- 'FileName'

#set sample names 
temp$SampleName <- sub("\\..*$", "", temp$FileName)
names <- temp
colnames(df) <- names$SampleName

#create matrix
count_mat <- as.matrix(df)

#export raw matrix
write.csv(
  count_mat,
  file = "bac_raw_matrix_before_DESEQ.csv",
  row.names = TRUE
)

```

<br>
**4. create meta file**
```{r sample-info,  message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
sample_info <- read.delim("DE_bac_meta.txt")
df_rownames <- sample_info$Sample
rownames(sample_info) <- df_rownames
sample_info <- sample_info[,2:6]
```

<br>
**6. create DEseq2 object (via DESeqDataSet)**
```{r deseq,  message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# one object containing all data
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = count_mat,
                              colData = sample_info,
                              design= ~ Treat)

#remove rows with low read counts
dds  <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds))>10]

#group=factor(sample_info$Treat)
#design(dds) = ~ group
dds = DESeq(dds, test = "LRT", reduced = ~ 1)
res=results(dds)
vsd <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)
normalized_counts <- assay(vsd)
sig_genes <- rownames(res)[which(res$padj < 0.05 & !is.na(res$padj))] # Filter significant genes (adjust the threshold as needed)

normalized_counts <- normalized_counts[rownames(normalized_counts) %in% sig_genes,]
normalized_counts_df <- as.data.frame(normalized_counts)
normalized_counts_df <- tibble::rownames_to_column(normalized_counts_df, var = "Gene_ID")
write.table(normalized_counts_df, file = "DE_vst_bacteria.txt", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

```
